# ===================================================================
# SELECTION RANGE — SMART EXPAND / SHRINK SELECTION
# ===================================================================
# This file demonstrates the Selection Range feature.
#
# HOW TO USE:
#   1. Place your cursor on any token below
#   2. Press Shift+Alt+Right to expand the selection
#   3. Press Shift+Alt+Left  to shrink the selection
#
# The selection expands through meaningful CK3 script structures
# instead of generic brace-matching.
#
# TRY IT: Place cursor on "yes" in the trigger below and expand.
# Expected expansion order:
#   yes -> is_alive = yes -> inner { } content -> limit = { ... }
#   -> inner every_vassal content -> every_vassal = { ... }
#   -> inner immediate content -> immediate = { ... }
#   -> inner event content -> selection_demo.0001 = { ... }
#   -> entire file

# ===================================================================

namespace = selection_demo

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Event 1: Deeply nested blocks
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Try expanding from values at different nesting depths.
# Each level should be a distinct expansion step.
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
selection_demo.0001 = {
	type = character_event
	title = selection_demo.0001.t
	desc = selection_demo.0001.desc
	theme = realm

	trigger = {
		is_ruler = yes
		is_alive = yes
		age >= 16
	}

	immediate = {
		every_vassal = {
			limit = {
				is_alive = yes
				is_adult = yes
			}
			add_opinion = {
				modifier = grateful_opinion
				target = root
				opinion = 20
			}
		}
	}

	# Option with nested effect block
	option = {
		name = selection_demo.0001.a
		trigger = {
			prestige >= 500
		}
		add_prestige = 100
		stress_impact = {
			ambitious = -10
			content = 10
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = selection_demo.0001.b
		add_gold = 50
	}
}

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Event 2: Comparisons and lists
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Try expanding on comparison operators (>=, <, etc.)
# and values inside list structures.
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
selection_demo.0002 = {
	type = character_event
	title = selection_demo.0002.t
	desc = selection_demo.0002.desc

	trigger = {
		age >= 16
		age < 65
		prestige >= 1000
		NOT = { has_trait = incapable }
	}

	weight_multiplier = {
		base = 1
		modifier = {
			add = 2
			has_trait = ambitious
		}
		modifier = {
			factor = 0.5
			age >= 50
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_list = {
			10 = {
				add_gold = 100
				add_prestige = 50
			}
			20 = {
				add_gold = 200
			}
			30 = {
				add_piety = 150
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = selection_demo.0002.a
	}
}

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Comment block grouping
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Selection range also groups consecutive comments.
# Place your cursor on any of these comment lines and expand:
# the single line selects first, then the entire comment block,
# then the file.
# -------------------------------------------------------------------

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Event 3: Simple flat structure
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Useful for testing selection on single-level assignments.
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
selection_demo.0003 = {
	type = letter_event
	title = selection_demo.0003.t
	desc = selection_demo.0003.desc
	sender = root
	hidden = no
	cooldown = { months = 6 }

	option = {
		name = selection_demo.0003.a
	}
}
